speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have right knee swelling and a family history of similar issues; to begin, have you experienced any knee injuries, and does your pain worsen with activity or rest? Also, have you noticed any swelling in your fingers or toes?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis (Systemic JIA) or Familial Hyperuricemia. REQUEST TEST: CBC, ESR, CRP, Uric Acid. REQUEST IMAGES: Right knee X-ray.
